title: 'Kimi no Koto ga Daidaidaidaidaisuki na 100-nin no Kanojo 3rd Season' Announces Supporting Cast
content: The official website of the Kimi no Koto ga Daidaidaidaidaisuki na 100-nin no Kanojo ( The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You ) announced a supporting pair of cast for its third season on Sunday. The new season premiered on Tokyo MX at 10.30 p.m on Sunday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 30 Years Later, Legendary Sci-Fi Officially Confirms Return With New Revival Anime
content: A legendary science-fiction anime has confirmed it’s now in the works on a brand new revival series 30 years after the original came to an end. There are very few franchises that anime fans unanimously refer to as classics , and even fewer that are considered pillars of the medium itself.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Grotesqqque' Reveals Additional Staff, Opening Theme, Trailer, November 2026 Premiere
content: The CloverWorks Industry Panel at Anime Expo 2026 revealed additional staff, the opening theme song, a key visual (pictured), and the main trailer on Sunday for the Grotesqqque original anime movie. The film is scheduled to premiere in Japanese theaters on November 6.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Season 3 Debuts New Look at Next Major Villain
content: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End is now in the works on Season 3 of the anime, and fans have gotten a closer look at the next major villain coming to screens with a new teaser for the next episodes.

title: Mononoke Franchise Reveals New Project Featuring New Medicine Seller
content: Twin Engine revealed on Sunday in a promotional video that a new Mononoke project has started, and introduced the third Medicine Seller "Ken no Tsurugi." Actor Hirofumi Araki , who starred as the Medicine Seller in the recent Mononoke stage plays will voice the new character.
